imageUrls.title: Image URLs
imageUrls.description: Direct links to images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, BMP, GIF). Each image becomes one dataset item.

language.title: Language
language.description: Text language. Combine with + for mixed text (eng+fra).

includeWordBoxes.title: Include word bounding boxes
includeWordBoxes.description: Add every word with its confidence and pixel position (left, top, width, height).

pageSegmentationMode.title: Layout mode
pageSegmentationMode.description: Tesseract page segmentation mode: 3 = automatic (documents), 6 = single block of text, 11 = sparse text (signs, screenshots, UI).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many images to process in parallel.
